Elegant 4-Bedroom Residence with Marina & Water Views | Palazzo Versace Dubai

Indulge in the epitome of luxury with this exquisite 4-bedroom, 5-bathroom residence at the renowned Palazzo Versace Dubai. Masterfully crafted to blend timeless Italian elegance with contemporary design, this expansive home boasts soaring ceilings, custom Versace finishes, and sweeping views of the marina and serene waterfront.

Property Highlights:

4 Bedrooms
5 Bathrooms
3 Dedicated Parking Spaces
Generous Layout with High Ceilings and Signature Versace Interiors
Full Marina & Water Views from Living and Bedroom Areas
State-of-the-Art Kitchen with Premium Appliances
Dedicated Laundry and Storage Room
Access to 5-Star Hotel Amenities: Swimming Pool, Gym, Spa, Valet & Concierge Services
24/7 Security and Secure Parking

Prime Location:

Minutes from Downtown Dubai, Business Bay, and Dubai International Airport.

Presented by:

Provident Real Estate
